name: notes
description: Find and add notes in the notebooks of a Notes account.

token.title: API token
token.description: From Settings, API tokens, in the Notes account the agents should act as.

tools.name: find_notes
tools.description: Search the notes in one notebook the agent's access names. Reads only.

tools.name: add_note
tools.description: Add a note to a notebook the agent's access names, when its access allows adding. Creates a note in the account.

tools.name: list_notebooks
tools.description: List the account's notebooks, for the access form. Reads only.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Name the account the connection signs in as, for Test connection. Reads only.

notebooks.title: Notebooks
notebooks.description: The notebooks the agent may search.

add.title: May add notes
add.description: Lets the agent add notes to those notebooks.
